title: The role of water in mediating DNA structures with epigenetic modifications, higher-order conformations and drug–DNA interactions
content:
RSC Chem. Biol., 2025, 6,699-720
DOI: 10.1039/D4CB00308J, Review Article
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Roshan Satange, Ming-Hon Hou
This review explores the role of water in canonical and non-canonical DNA structures, highlighting water-mediated interactions in small molecule groove binding, intercalation, and recent advances in studying water–nucleic acid interactions.
